items.source: existingBean - the existing bean instance
items.translation: existingBean - 现有的 Bean 实例

items.source: as of 6.1, in favor of implicit post-processing through initializeBean(Object, String)
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，转而通过 initializeBean(Object, String) 进行隐式后处理。

items.source: Resolve the specified dependency against the beans defined in this factory.
items.translation: 解析该工厂中定义的 bean 以解决指定的依赖关系。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean, to be passed to it if necessary (only passed to BeanPostProcessors; can follow the ORIGINAL_INSTANCE_SUFFIX convention in order to enforce the given instance to be returned, i.e. no proxies etc)
items.translation: beanName - bean 的名称，必要时会传递给它 （仅传递给BeanPostProcessors； 可以遵循ORIGINAL_INSTANCE_SUFFIX约定以强制返回给定的实例，即不返回代理等）

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if no matching bean was found
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果未找到匹配的 Bean

items.source: NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException - if more than one matching bean was found
items.translation: NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException - 如果找到多个匹配的 Bean

items.source: the bean instance to use, either the original or a wrapped one
items.translation: 要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例。

items.source: Does not apply standard BeanPostProcessors callbacks or perform any further initialization of the bean. This interface offers distinct, fine-grained operations for those purposes, for example initializeBean(Object, String). However, InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor callbacks are applied, if applicable to the configuration of the instance.
items.translation: not 不应用标准的 BeanPostProcessors回调或执行任何进一步的 bean 初始化。该接口为此目的提供了不同的、细粒度的操作，例如initializeBean(Object, String)。然而，如果适用于实例的配置，则会应用 InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor回调。

items.source: in favor of createBean(Class)
items.translation: 支持使用createBean(Class)。

items.source: BeansException - if instantiation or wiring failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果实例化或装配失败

items.source: BeansException - if wiring failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果配置失败

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean definition with the given name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在具有给定名称的 Bean 定义

items.source: BeansException - if the initialization failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果初始化失败

items.source: BeansException - if dependency resolution failed for any other reason
items.translation: BeansException - 如果依赖解析因其他任何原因失败

items.source: beanClass - the class of the bean to create
items.translation: beanClass - 要创建的 Bean 的类

items.source: autowireMode - by name or type, using the constants in this interface
items.translation: autowireMode - 通过此接口中的常量按名称或类型进行自动注入。

items.source: requestingBeanName - the name of the bean which declares the given dependency
items.translation: requestingBeanName - 声明给定依赖的 Bean 的名称

items.source: the new bean instance
items.translation: 新的 Bean 实例

items.source: Does not apply standard BeanPostProcessors callbacks or perform any further initialization of the bean. This interface offers distinct, fine-grained operations for those purposes, for example initializeBean(Object, String). However, InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor callbacks are applied, if applicable to the construction of the instance.
items.translation: not 不应用标准的 BeanPostProcessors回调或执行任何进一步的 bean 初始化。该接口为此目的提供了不同的、细粒度的操作，例如initializeBean(Object, String)。然而，如果适用于实例的构建，则会应用 InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor回调。

items.source: Performs full initialization of the bean, including all applicable BeanPostProcessors. This is effectively a superset of what autowire(Class, int, boolean) provides, adding initializeBean(Object, String) behavior.
items.translation: 执行 Bean 的完整初始化，包括所有适用的BeanPostProcessors。这实际上是autowire(Class, int, boolean)所提供内容的超集，并添加了initializeBean(Object, String)的行为。

items.source: This subinterface of BeanFactory is not meant to be used in normal application code: stick to BeanFactory or ListableBeanFactory for typical use cases.
items.translation: 此 BeanFactory 的子接口并非用于常规应用程序代码：对于典型用例，请坚持使用BeanFactory或ListableBeanFactory。

items.source: Note that this interface is not implemented by ApplicationContext facades, as it is hardly ever used by application code. That said, it is available from an application context too, accessible through ApplicationContext's ApplicationContext.getAutowireCapableBeanFactory() method.
items.translation: 请注意，此接口并未由`ApplicationContext`门面实现，因为应用程序代码几乎从不使用它。尽管如此，它也可从应用程序上下文中获取，可通过`ApplicationContext`的ApplicationContext.getAutowireCapableBeanFactory()方法访问。

items.source: This method does not autowire bean properties; it just applies explicitly defined property values. Use the autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean) method to autowire an existing bean instance. Note: This method requires a bean definition for the given name!
items.translation: 此方法不会自动注入 Bean 属性；它仅应用显式定义的属性值。请使用autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean)方法为现有的 Bean 实例执行自动注入。注意：此方法需要给定名称的 Bean 定义！

items.source: This is effectively a variant of BeanFactory.getBean(String, Class) which supports factory methods with an InjectionPoint argument.
items.translation: 这实际上是 `BeanFactory.getBean(String, Class)` 的一个变体，支持带有 `InjectionPoint` 参数的工厂方法。

items.source: Note: This is essentially intended for (re-)populating annotated fields and methods, either for new instances or for deserialized instances. It does not imply traditional by-name or by-type autowiring of properties; use autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean) for those purposes.
items.translation: 注意：这本质上旨在为新的实例或反序列化的实例重新填充已注解的字段和方法。它不意味着按名称或按类型的传统属性自动装配；请使用autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean)来实现这些目的。

items.source: This is effectively a superset of what initializeBean(Object, String) provides, fully applying the configuration specified by the corresponding bean definition. Note: This method requires a bean definition for the given name!
items.translation: 这实际上是 `initializeBean(Object, String)` 所提供内容的超集，完全应用了对应 Bean 定义中指定的配置。 注意：此方法需要给定名称的 Bean 定义！

items.source: You may also implement the BeanFactoryAware interface, which exposes the internal BeanFactory even when running in an ApplicationContext, to get access to an AutowireCapableBeanFactory: simply cast the passed-in BeanFactory to AutowireCapableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 您也可以实现BeanFactoryAware接口，即使在 ApplicationContext 中运行时，该接口也能暴露内部 BeanFactory，以便访问 AutowireCapableBeanFactory：只需将传入的 BeanFactory 强制转换为 AutowireCapableBeanFactory。

items.source: Performs full initialization of the bean, including all applicable BeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 执行 Bean 的完整初始化，包括所有适用的 BeanPostProcessors。

items.source: Note: This is intended for creating a fresh instance, populating annotated fields and methods as well as applying all standard bean initialization callbacks. Constructor resolution is based on Kotlin primary / single public / single non-public, with a fallback to the default constructor in ambiguous scenarios, also influenced by SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.determineCandidateConstructors(Class, String) (for example, for annotation-driven constructor selection).
items.translation: 注意：此功能旨在创建新实例，填充已注解的字段和方法，并应用所有标准的 Bean 初始化回调。构造函数的解析基于 Kotlin 的主构造函数/单个公共构造函数/单个非公共构造函数，在存在歧义的场景下会回退到默认构造函数，同时也受以下因素影响：SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.determineCandidateConstructors(Class, String)（例如，用于注解驱动的构造函数选择）。

items.source: This is effectively a variant of BeanFactory.getBean(Class) which preserves the bean name of the matching instance.
items.translation: 这实际上是 `BeanFactory.getBean(Class)` 的一个变体，它会保留匹配实例的 bean 名称。

items.source:
Integration code for other frameworks can leverage this interface to
wire and populate existing bean instances that Spring does not control
the lifecycle of. This is particularly useful for WebWork Actions and
Tapestry Page objects, for example.
items.translation: 其他框架的集成代码可以利用此接口来配置和填充现有 Bean 实例，这些实例的生命周期不受 Spring 控制。这对于 WebWork Action 和 Tapestry Page 对象等尤其有用。

items.source:
Note that no bean definition of the given name has to exist
in the bean factory. The passed-in bean name will simply be used
for callbacks but not checked against the registered bean definitions.
items.translation: 请注意，无需在 Bean 工厂中存在给定名称的 Bean 定义。传入的 Bean 名称将仅用于回调，而不会与已注册的 Bean 定义进行核对。

items.source: Destroy the given bean instance (typically coming from createBean(Class)), applying the DisposableBean contract as well as registered DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 销毁给定的 Bean 实例（通常来自createBean(Class)），同时应用DisposableBean契约以及已注册的DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessors。

items.source: Apply BeanPostProcessors to the given existing bean instance, invoking their postProcessBeforeInitialization methods. The returned bean instance may be a wrapper around the original.
items.translation: 将 `BeanPostProcessors` 应用于给定的现有 Bean 实例，调用它们的 `postProcessBeforeInitialization` 方法。返回的 Bean 实例可能是原始实例的包装器。

items.source: Apply BeanPostProcessors to the given existing bean instance, invoking their postProcessAfterInitialization methods. The returned bean instance may be a wrapper around the original.
items.translation: 将 `BeanPostProcessors` 应用于给定的现有 Bean 实例，调用它们的 `postProcessAfterInitialization` 方法。返回的 Bean 实例可能是原始实例的包装器。

items.source:
If you are using mixed autowiring strategies, prefer
annotation-based autowiring for clearer demarcation of autowiring needs.
items.translation: 如果您使用混合自动装配策略，请优先采用基于注解的自动装配方式，以更清晰地界定自动装配需求。

items.source:
Constant that indicates autowiring bean properties by name
(applying to all bean property setters).
items.translation: 指示通过名称自动装配 Bean 属性的常量（适用于所有 Bean 属性 setter）。

items.source:
Constant that indicates autowiring bean properties by type
(applying to all bean property setters).
items.translation: 指示通过类型自动装配 Bean 属性的常量（适用于所有 Bean 属性 setter）。

items.source:
Constant that indicates autowiring the greediest constructor that
can be satisfied (involves resolving the appropriate constructor).
items.translation: 指示自动装配最贪婪的构造函数（涉及解析适当的构造函数）的常量。

items.source:
Constant that indicates no externally defined autowiring. Note that
BeanFactoryAware etc and annotation-driven injection will still be applied.
items.translation: 指示未定义外部自动装配的常量。请注意，BeanFactoryAware 等接口以及基于注解的注入仍将生效。

items.source:
Constant that indicates determining an appropriate autowire strategy
through introspection of the bean class.
items.translation: 指示通过内省 Bean 类来确定适当的自动装配策略的常量。

items.source:
Suffix for the "original instance" convention when initializing an existing
bean instance: to be appended to the fully-qualified bean class name,
for example, "com.mypackage.MyClass.ORIGINAL", in order to enforce the given instance
to be returned, i.e. no proxies etc.
items.translation: 用于初始化现有 Bean 实例时“原始实例”约定的后缀：将追加到完全限定的 Bean 类名之后，例如 "com.mypackage.MyClass.ORIGINAL"，以强制返回给定的实例，即不返回代理等。

items.source: BeansException - if applying the property values failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果应用属性值失败

items.source: BeansException - if any post-processing failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果任何后处理失败

items.source: BeansException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no bean with the specified name
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果不存在指定名称的 Bean

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean, to be passed to it if necessary (a bean definition of that name has to be available)
items.translation: beanName - 要传递给它（如有必要）的 Bean 名称（必须存在该名称的 Bean 定义）

items.source: dependencyCheck - whether to perform a dependency check for objects (not applicable to autowiring a constructor, thus ignored there)
items.translation: dependencyCheck - 是否对对象执行依赖检查（不适用于构造函数自动装配，因此在此处被忽略）

items.source: dependencyCheck - whether to perform a dependency check for object references in the bean instance (not applicable to autowiring a constructor, thus ignored there)
items.translation: dependencyCheck - 是否对 Bean 实例中的对象引用执行依赖检查（不适用于构造函数自动装配，因此在此处被忽略）

items.source: dependencyCheck - whether to perform a dependency check for object references in the bean instance
items.translation: dependencyCheck - 是否对 Bean 实例中的对象引用执行依赖检查

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean definition in the bean factory (a bean definition of that name has to be available)
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中 bean 定义的名称（必须存在该名称的 bean 定义）

items.source: existingBean - the bean instance to destroy
items.translation: existingBean - 要销毁的 Bean 实例

items.source: name - the name of the bean to look up
items.translation: name - 要查找的 Bean 的名称

items.source: descriptor - the dependency descriptor for the requesting injection point
items.translation: descriptor - 请求注入点的依赖描述符

items.source: descriptor - the descriptor for the dependency (field/method/constructor)
items.translation: descriptor - 依赖（字段/方法/构造函数）的描述符

items.source: the resolved object, or null if none found
items.translation: 已解析的对象，或者如果未找到则为null

items.source: autowiredBeanNames - a Set that all names of autowired beans (used for resolving the given dependency) are supposed to be added to
items.translation: autowiredBeanNames - 一个集合，所有用于解析给定依赖的自动装配 Bean 的名称都应添加到该集合中。

items.source: typeConverter - the TypeConverter to use for populating arrays and collections
items.translation: typeConverter - 用于填充数组和集合的 TypeConverter

items.source: the bean name plus bean instance
items.translation: bean 名称加上 bean 实例

items.source: the corresponding bean instance
items.translation: 对应的 Bean 实例

items.source:
Any exception that arises during destruction should be caught
and logged instead of propagated to the caller of this method.
items.translation: 任何在销毁过程中引发的异常都应被捕获并记录，而不是传播到此方法的调用者。

items.source: Configure the given raw bean: autowiring bean properties, applying bean property values, applying factory callbacks such as setBeanName and setBeanFactory, and also applying all bean post processors (including ones which might wrap the given raw bean).
items.translation: 配置给定的原始 Bean：自动装配 Bean 属性、应用 Bean 属性值、应用工厂回调（如 `setBeanName` 和 `setBeanFactory`），以及应用所有 Bean 后处理器（包括可能包装给定原始 Bean 的处理器）。

items.source: Initialize the given raw bean, applying factory callbacks such as setBeanName and setBeanFactory, also applying all bean post processors (including ones which might wrap the given raw bean).
items.translation: 初始化给定的原始 Bean，应用工厂回调（例如setBeanName和setBeanFactory），并应用所有 Bean 后处理器（包括可能包装给定原始 Bean 的处理器）。

items.source: Constant that indicates no externally defined autowiring.
items.translation: 指示未定义外部自动装配的常量。

to be returned, i.e.
items.translation: 用于初始化现有 Bean 实例时“原始实例”约定的后缀：将追加到完全限定的 Bean 类名之后，例如"com.mypackage.MyClass.ORIGINAL"，以强制返回给定的实例，即

items.source:
Apply the property values of the bean definition with the given name to
the given bean instance.
items.translation: 将给定名称的 Bean 定义属性值应用到给定的 Bean 实例上。

items.source:
Instantiate a new bean instance of the given class with the specified autowire
strategy.
items.translation: 使用指定的自动装配策略实例化给定类的新 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Populate the given bean instance through applying after-instantiation callbacks
and bean property post-processing (for example, for annotation-driven injection).
items.translation: 通过应用实例化后回调和 Bean 属性后置处理（例如，用于基于注解的注入）来填充给定的 Bean 实例。

items.source: Autowire the bean properties of the given bean instance by name or type.
items.translation: 按名称或类型通过名称自动注入给定 Bean 实例的 Bean 属性。

items.source: Fully create a new bean instance of the given class.
items.translation: 为给定类完全创建一个新的 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Resolve a bean instance for the given bean name, providing a dependency descriptor
for exposure to target factory methods.
items.translation: 为给定的 Bean 名称解析一个 Bean 实例，并提供依赖描述符以供目标工厂方法暴露。

items.source:
Resolve the bean instance that uniquely matches the given object type, if any,
including its bean name.
items.translation: 解析唯一匹配给定对象类型（如果存在）的 Bean 实例，包括其 Bean 名称。

items.source: beanClass - the class of the bean to instantiate
items.translation: beanClass - 要实例化的 Bean 的类

items.source: requiredType - type the bean must match; can be an interface or superclass
items.translation: requiredType - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型；可以是接口或父类
